question: In a football match, the length of a pitch must be between ________ and 120 m.
solution:
The correct answer is __**90**** **m.__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **minimum length of a football pitch** according to the laws of the game is 9**0 m **and the maximum length is** 120 m.**
 
• The length of a football pitch is a crucial factor that affects the gameplay, and it must be within the** prescribed limits **to ensure a fair and competitive match.
 
• The dimensions of a football pitch also include the width, which must be between **45 m and 90 m,** and the goal area, penalty area, and center circle, which have specific measurements.
 
• The laws of the game also specify other rules related to the pitch, such as the** type of surface, markings, and equipment,** which must be followed to ensure the safety and integrity of the game.

• **Football **refers to a group of team sports that, in varying degrees, involve** kicking a ball **in order to score goals.

• The standard number of players for **two teams** is between **11 and 18, **though some variants with fewer players (five or more per team) are also common.
